name: fade-rise
purpose: Reveal one stable section root with a short opacity and upward transform transition.

cwvImpact.rationale: The visual state changes only through opacity and transform using host motion tokens.

accessibility.reducedMotionFallback: Stops motion and leaves the target visible in its final state.

cwvTripwire.layoutShift: Only opacity and transform may transition.
cwvTripwire.longAnimation: A bounded host semantic duration token is required for every transition.
cwvTripwire.durationCap: Timing is limited to the host semantic duration tokens.
